Cenovus Energy Inc. (2025). Christina Lake In-situ Progress Report, Scheme 8591, 2024 update. Directive 054 annual in situ performance presentation to the Alberta Energy Regulator, Calgary, 30 June 2025.

Reporting year 2024 (deck titled "2024 update", dated June 30, 2025). Loaded: scheme-level 2024 plant performance from slide 32 only - system and approved oil capacity, 2024 annual bitumen output (37,300 Sm3/d x 366 d), utilization 83%, and a steam input flow per m3 bitumen (77,614 t/d / 37,300 Sm3/d = 2.08, derived SOR). Other-values: steam capacities, pad count, NCG co-injection condition, cumulative recovery. Not available in this deck: fuel gas use, purchased/produced gas, electricity import/export, cogeneration capacity (gas turbines GT-2900/2950 are mentioned on slide 41 without ratings), GHG emissions, produced/make-up/disposal water volumes and recycle rate, steam generator counts and efficiency, solvent (none injected, slide 24). Water treatment is de-oiling + warm lime softening + OTSGs (slides 37, 39-41) but no volumes, so no separator_warm-lime-softening row. Slide 8 production history is a chart without value labels (not read). Skipped geology, seismic, monitoring, compliance and regulatory slides. Locator convention: printed slide numbers (= PDF page). Traps: steam printed in t/d and oil in Sm3/d; t steam taken as m3 CWE; 2024 leap year (366 d); approved capacity includes unbuilt Phase H; scheme is SAGD with late-life NCG co-injection, not solvent-assisted.
